issuer: the Department of Road Transport and Services (DRTS)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Government of Botswana's own service pages (gov.bw). Driving Licence Application: the minimum age for class B and EB (light motor vehicles of 3,500 kg or less) is 18 (16 for a tractor, 21 for heavy vehicles); the applicant passes the theory test, takes a provisional learner's licence and then the yard and road tests at the Department of Road Transport Services (DRTS; 'Road Transport and Services' on the renewal page); the Botswana driving licence card is valid for five years. Driving Licence Card Renewal: valid five years; 'Renewal or first issue cost is P105,00', held as the card's fee (the learner's licence and test fees aren't given there and aren't held). SADC licences may be used without conversion and other foreign licences are converted with a verification letter; the page doesn't say whether a test is set, so no exchange list is held. No identity card is issued by the DRTS (the Omang is the Department of Civil and National Registration's).
